name: RadioMaster Pocket Radio Controller
description: The RadioMaster Pocket is a compact, full-featured radio controller with ExpressLRS built-in. Perfect for pilots who want a portable yet capable radio for freestyle and racing.

name: RadioMaster Boxer M2 Radio Controller
description: The RadioMaster Boxer M2 is a full-size OpenTX/EdgeTX radio with hall sensor gimbals, ELRS module and multi-protocol support for all modern FPV systems.

name: RadioMaster GX12 Radio Controller
description: RadioMaster GX12 — a 12-channel EdgeTX transmitter with built-in ELRS 2.4GHz module and color display. Ideal for advanced FPV and fixed-wing pilots.

name: RadioMaster TX12 Radio Controller
description: The RadioMaster TX12 is a lightweight EdgeTX radio with hall sensor gimbals and built-in ExpressLRS 2.4GHz module. Great all-round radio for FPV and multirotors.

name: RadioMaster Nomad Radio Controller
description: RadioMaster Nomad — an entry-level EdgeTX radio with built-in ELRS. Compact and affordable, perfect for beginner to intermediate FPV pilots.

name: RadioMaster TX16S MK3 Radio Controller (ELRS / M2)
description: The RadioMaster TX16S MK3 is the flagship 16-channel transmitter featuring dual hall sensor gimbals, built-in ELRS module, and full EdgeTX compatibility. The gold standard for serious FPV pilots.

name: RadioMaster AX12 Android Radio Controller
description: RadioMaster AX12 — the world's first Android-based RC transmitter. Runs EdgeTX and Android simultaneously, with a built-in 7" touchscreen, ELRS module, and full Google Play Store access.

name: Radiomaster XR1 Nano Receiver
description: Ultra-lightweight ExpressLRS 2.4GHz nano receiver. Weighs just 1g and supports CRSF/SBUS output. Perfect for micro builds and 5-inch racing quads.

name: Radiomaster XR1 Nano Multi-Frequency ELRS Receiver (Dual Band)
description: The Radiomaster XR1 Nano Dual Band supports both 2.4GHz and 900MHz ExpressLRS for maximum range and penetration in any environment.

name: RadioMaster RP3 V2 ExpressLRS 2.4GHz Nano Receiver
description: RadioMaster RP3 V2 — compact ELRS 2.4GHz nano receiver with ceramic antenna, CRSF telemetry, and wide compatibility with FPV flight controllers.

name: Radiomaster ER4 2.4GHz ELRS PWM Receiver
description: The Radiomaster ER4 is a 4-channel ELRS PWM receiver ideal for fixed-wing aircraft and traditional RC models. Direct PWM output, no flight controller required.

name: GEPRC ELRS 915M/2.4G Gemini Xrossband Receiver
description: GEPRC Gemini Xrossband receiver supports both 915MHz and 2.4GHz ELRS simultaneously for superior range and reliability in challenging RF environments.

name: Ranger Nano 2.4GHz ExpressLRS RF Module
description: The Ranger Nano is a high-power 2.4GHz ELRS external RF module compatible with JR/MULTI-module bay radios. Delivers long-range performance in a compact form factor.

name: Radiomaster T8L ExpressLRS Radio Controller (White)
description: The Radiomaster T8L is a pistol-grip style EdgeTX radio with built-in 2.4GHz ELRS, designed for surface and boat RC vehicles with an ergonomic wheel-and-trigger layout.

name: Radiomaster T8L ExpressLRS Radio Controller (Grey)
description: The Radiomaster T8L Grey edition — pistol-grip style EdgeTX radio with built-in 2.4GHz ELRS, designed for surface RC vehicles with wheel-and-trigger ergonomics.

name: 1800TVL BAT1 Night Vision Analog FPV Camera
description: 1800TVL BAT1 night vision analog FPV camera with starlight sensor. Delivers crisp low-light video for dawn/dusk flying and indoor FPV applications.

name: 1500TVL Analog FPV Mini Camera
description: Compact 1500TVL analog FPV mini camera. Wide dynamic range, low latency, and standard 19×19mm mounting. Compatible with all 5.8GHz analog FPV systems.

name: SIYI A2 Mini Ultra Wide Angle FPV Gimbal
description: SIYI A2 Mini single-axis tilt gimbal with 160° FOV 1080p starlight camera sensor. IP67 waterproof, supports upside-down mount mode. Perfect for inspection and cinematic FPV drones.

name: SIYI A8 Mini 4K 8MP Gimbal Camera
description: SIYI A8 Mini — 4K 8MP ultra HD gimbal camera with 6x digital zoom and starlight night vision. Compact design for professional aerial photography and inspection drones.

name: CADDX Walksnail Avatar HD Goggles L
description: Walksnail Avatar HD Goggles L with built-in DVR, 1080p 60fps dual display, and 100+ channel support. The ultimate digital FPV goggle for Avatar HD system users.

name: DJI Goggles N3
description: DJI Goggles N3 — next-generation digital FPV goggles with low latency, HD transmission, and OSD overlay. Compatible with DJI O3, O4, and newer digital systems.

name: DJI O4 Lite Video Transmission System
description: DJI O4 Lite digital FPV transmission system — delivers 1080p 60fps low-latency video up to 13km range. Lightweight and compact for 3-5 inch FPV builds.

name: DJI O4 Pro Video Transmission System
description: DJI O4 Pro — flagship digital FPV system with 1080p/120fps ultra-low latency transmission, up to 20km range, and integrated OSD. For serious FPV and professional applications.

name: SIYI HM30 Full HD Digital FPV System
description: SIYI HM30 full HD digital image transmission system with 30km range, 1080p streaming, and dual operator support. Built for professional UAV operations and long-range FPV.

name: CADDX FPV Vista 20cm Coaxial Cable
description: 20cm coaxial cable for CADDX FPV Vista digital air unit. High-quality shielded cable for connecting the Vista unit to your FPV camera.

name: iFlight Analog FPV Goggles with DVR
description: iFlight analog FPV goggles with built-in DVR recording, auto-search, and 40-channel 5.8GHz receiver. Great entry-level goggles for analog FPV systems.

name: GEPRC MATEN 5.8G 5W VTX PRO
description: GEPRC MATEN 5.8GHz 5W high-power video transmitter with 48 channels, IRC Tramp protocol support, and smart power management. Ideal for long-range analog FPV.

name: RAD Tiny 5.8G 400mW VTX
description: RAD Tiny 5.8GHz 400mW video transmitter — ultra-compact VTX with 48 channels, pit mode, and SmartAudio support. Perfect for 3-5 inch FPV race builds.

name: GEPRC Momoda2 5.8G Antenna LHCP SMA 90mm

name: Foxeer Pagoda PRO 5.8G RHCP FPV Antenna

name: Triple Feed Patch-1 SMA Antenna

name: GEPRC Momoda2 5.8G Antenna RHCP UFL 150mm
